description: The optional fundamentals module for people who have never programmed; a learner who can solve the 00/07 challenge without help starts at module 01.
A C# exercise that runs in the browser, where Run executes the program and Run tests grades it against the lesson's tests.
A module-closing exercise built locally with the .NET 10 SDK and self-checked against acceptance criteria.
An ASP.NET Core application is one process that serves many concurrent requests, so static fields and singletons are shared across all of them until the process stops.
The C# compiler checks types before the program runs and rejects a value of the wrong type, so no program is produced with that mistake in it.
A shared set of threads that runs request code in .NET, so a thread blocked on I/O reduces capacity for every other request.
Services, configuration and endpoints are registered in C# code that is read from top to bottom.
